purpose: Reduce performance loss under one-feed outages without reconstructing or imputing the missing feed. Train a dedicated classifier directly on the raw causal feature families that remain available, preserving cross-family interactions that scalar expert fusion can discard.

architecture.FULL: unchanged promoted positive-evidence stack; not retuned
architecture.NO_XRS: five-seed direct XGBoost ensemble on SOLAR+PROTON raw causal predictors
architecture.NO_PROTON: five-seed direct XGBoost ensemble on SOLAR+XRS raw causal predictors
architecture.NO_XRS_OR_PROTON: five-seed direct XGBoost ensemble on SOLAR raw causal predictors
architecture.xgboost_recipe: exact public NEW-crossing benchmark XGBoost hyperparameters

roles.threshold: MAX_TSS and POD80_MIN_FAR threshold selection only
roles.monitor: excluded before any fitting, calibration, thresholding, prediction export, or metric calculation

primary_comparison.NO_XRS: direct raw-feature specialist v2 versus scalar-fusion fallback v1 on identical score rows
primary_comparison.NO_PROTON: direct raw-feature specialist v2 versus scalar-fusion fallback v1 on identical score rows
primary_comparison.NO_XRS_OR_PROTON: direct solar specialist v2 versus solar-family fallback v1 on identical score rows

keep_v2_for_final_locked_evaluation_only: whole-score primary MAX_TSS is not lower than v1 by more than 0.02
whole-score Brier score is not worse than v1 by more than 0.005
whole-score ECE is not worse than v1 by more than 0.01
5-percent operator-review enrichment is not lower than v1 by more than 1.0x
probabilities are finite and no unavailable family is silently substituted

claim_boundary: A favorable development result only freezes v2 as the candidate to be taken to the untouched evaluation. It does not establish NORMAL trust, final superiority, operational certification, or missing-sensor reconstruction accuracy.
